profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Amerisleep
profile.summary:
Experienced Full Stack Developer

With technology being highly prevalent in today's society, I always look forward to being a contributor towards the evolution of software.

Skills: JavaScript, Node.js, MySQL, NoSQL, Docker, Nginx
Frameworks: React.js, Vue.js, Express.js

Portfolio: www.nguyenchris.com
GitHub: github.com/nguyenchris
Feel free to contact me: chrisnguyenaz@gmail.com

positions.title: iOS Senior Advisor
positions.description:
- Assisted AppleCare Engineering with identifying, troubleshooting, and submitting details regarding unexpected software behavior
- Took full ownership of customer cases from escalating advisors due to complex technical issues--requiring consistent customer follow up until resolution
- Exceeded business expectations for all major metrical key performance indicators during the annual performance review of fiscal year 2018
- Obtained an overall 97% customer satisfaction rate based on random surveys

positions.title: iOS and Mac Technical Advisor (College Program)
positions.description:
- Created multiple interactive job aid articles and documents which enhanced team's productivity and performance
- Obtained a 98% customer satisfaction rate
- Exceeded business expectations for all major KPI's in the annual performance review of fiscal year 2017

positions.title: Mac+ Mentor (College Program)
positions.description:
- Selected, based on top performance, as one of the 20 advisors to mentor newly trained advisors transitioning from iOS to macOS product knowledge
- Lead group discussions for newly trained advisors--focusing on areas of opportunity in order to enhance their technical software/hardware knowledge

positions.title: Proctor/Technical Support
positions.description:
- Provided customer service and technical support for students taking their exams online in their homes.
- Troubleshooted technical issues with business internal tools as well as students' macOS and Windows operating systems, internet connectivity, and browser compatibility issues
- Consistently achieved top performing metrics

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Act as a liaison between the Arizona State University Greek Office, Chapter and the National Board
- Ensure the Chapter completes mandatory requirements set by the University as well as attend when needed
- Provide guidance and advice to the Chapter

Eliminate starvation in children throughout the world by helping to instill compassion in people to hear and respond to the cries of those in need through volunteer services and fundraising. Hand-pack rice, soy, dried vegetables and a nutritionally complete blend of vitamins and minerals into bags which are then sealed, boxed, placed on pallets and shipped to our incredible partners working hard to reach the neediest children around the world.
